component.name: Denso
component.summary: Run your shop: sales, stock, money and staff in one place

description.p: Denso is a business management app for shops, kitchens and small chains. Sell at the till, keep stock right across branches, track debts, expenses and payments, and see every figure agree with the books.

ul.li: Point of sale with cash, M-Pesa, Airtel Money, card and bank payments
Stock, recipes, suppliers, buying and branch transfers
Customers, debts, loyalty points, promotions and an online store
Workers, roles, shifts, rider deliveries and reports

description.p: Denso is commercial software by Codensons. Downloading is free; using it needs a paid plan. Updates are signed and delivered by the app itself from the official release page.
